required_before_work: Fast startup: read index.json, projectbrief.md, and activeContext.md only.
Load non-startup memory files only when relevant to the task; never preload history or archives.
Translate raw wording into real intent, success criteria, non-goals, confirmed facts, assumptions, and open questions.
If requirements/current.md is [UNINITIALIZED] and the user supplies requirements or a PRD, initialize the requirement baseline before implementation.
Latest User Intent Wins: a new explicit user requirement replaces the prior active requirement without a confirmation gate; preserve the old version as SUPERSEDED.
Requirement synchronization never means implementation or verification is complete.
Classify work as L0/L1/L2/L3; confirm only irreversible, permission-bound, or otherwise high-risk actions.
Use the current environment's available file read, search, edit, and write capability; do not depend on a specific tool API name.
Read the latest physical snapshot of target files and preserve explicit UTF-8 without BOM.
Use masterTaskLedger.md and task-packs for long-running, multi-agent, or context-heavy work.
Before completion, map every requested behavior and boundary in a Requirement Checklist and provide execution evidence.
On context compression, session resume, or model switch, rerun Fast startup and resume from activeContext.md.
intent_translation_contract: Separate confirmed facts, working assumptions, and open questions.
Preserve raw wording while recording the executable real intent.
Do not promote AI suggestions, examples, quoted opinions, or hypotheticals into requirements.
memory_write_triggers: Update activeContext.md at plan lock, verified checkpoints, requirement baseline changes, handoff, and status changes.
Write progress.md only for verified checkpoints and keep it as a bounded rolling window.
Primary memory files use a single-writer policy: only the main agent writes activeContext.md and progress.md.
Record every explicit requirement change in requirements/change-log.jsonl and update only affected memory files.
health_checks: Reject duplicate checkpoints, mojibake, and secrets.
resume_protocol: On context compression, model switch, or tool switch, rerun Fast startup.
Resume from activeContext.md and only its explicit Resume Reads.
Read the exact task pack or ledger entry when referenced.
Continue from the last verified checkpoint instead of replaying the conversation.
